tagline: A fully-offline clipboard history — searchable clips, pins that survive Clear, quick filters, double-click to re-copy, and 14 text transforms.
description: Never lose a copy again. Clipboard Manager 1.1 adopts the layout of Ditto while staying simple: every copy lands in a searchable, newest-first list; double-click any row to put it straight back on the clipboard. Pin the clips you never want to lose (they survive Clear and the history cap), and jump to the right clip with one-click filters — Pinned, Links, Multi-line, Today — each with a live count. The detail pane shows the full text with one-click Copy / Pin / Delete, plus 14 text transforms (UPPERCASE, slugify, base64, URL-encode, join/split lines and more) — the result is copied and saved as the newest clip. Add snippets by hand, pause capture any time from the header, and set the history size in Settings (Ctrl+,). Follows the system Aura Dark/Light theme live. Fully offline — only what you copy is stored, on this device, never uploaded.
